MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:

  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The workbench casters connect to my earlier hand truck interest by making heavy workshop equipment easier to move, provided they fit my bench.",

  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Electrical tape, heat shrink tubing, switches and wire connectors assume a wiring project that my recent fasteners and magnetic hooks do not establish.",

    "Concrete sealant, grinding discs, disposable gloves and a COVID test do not address the mounting, fastening or equipment-moving needs reflected in my history."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treat workshop supplies as broadly interchangeable, even when they support very different tasks.",
    "My interest in hardware assortments seems to have been extended to bulk electrical supplies without a reason I would need them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific uses of my recent items matter: magnetic attachment and metric fastening are more relevant than a general connection to tools.",
    "Compatibility matters before I act, including screw sizes, attachment surfaces and whether the casters can mount to my bench.",
    "I interact infrequently, so an item needs a clear connection to a current need rather than merely being something a workshop might use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized a broad workshop interest but mostly missed the specific fastening, organization and mobility needs that would make me act."
}
